items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I had met Sid Nathan. See, I knew Sid Nathan before I knew Glover... because I did a big hit for him.

ctx.x: No, this was either a trumpet player or saxophone player. These are the different men in the band.
But the most important thing was Glover and Bill Doggett came out of that particular band. We stayed there a whole year.
